tabtailor.editor.title: Tab Tailor
tabtailor.editor.hint: Drag to sort, click On/Off to hide. Shift + arrow keys move the selected tab.
tabtailor.editor.field.title: Title (empty = mod's own)
tabtailor.editor.open_file.tooltip: Opens this tab's file for sections and contents. Created if it does not exist yet. Use "Reload files" afterwards.
tabtailor.editor.reload.tooltip: Reads all files again, for example after editing them by hand
tabtailor.editor.discard.title: Discard changes?
tabtailor.editor.discard.message: You have unsaved changes. They will be lost.
tabtailor.editor.status.saved: Saved. A backup is in config/tabtailor/_backup/
tabtailor.editor.status.saved_problems: Saved with %s problem(s), see logs/latest.log or /tabtailor reload
tabtailor.editor.edit_sections.tooltip: Sections and contents of this tab, with item picker and live preview
tabtailor.sections.title: Sections: %s
tabtailor.sections.convert.tooltip: Creates a first section that keeps everything the tab has now ("*"). Add more sections after it.
tabtailor.sections.plain: This tab has no sections yet and shows its normal contents.
tabtailor.sections.field.title: Title (empty = no header row)
tabtailor.sections.field.icon: Icon for the side bar (empty = first item)
tabtailor.sections.add_entry.tooltip: Adds what you typed: an item ID, @mod, #tag, create:*_casing, tab:..., * or !... (Enter)
tabtailor.sections.exclude.tooltip: Items that this section must not take, even if an entry above matches them
tabtailor.sections.empty_items: Empty. Click items on the right (left click: the item, right click: the whole mod) or type an entry below.
tabtailor.sections.empty_exclude: Nothing excluded. Click items on the right to keep them out of this section.
tabtailor.sections.picker.right: Right click: add the whole mod (%s)
tabtailor.sections.preview.none: No preview yet: the creative tabs are built when you join a world. Open the editor in game for a preview.
tabtailor.sections.remove_confirm.title: Delete section "%s"?
tabtailor.sections.remove_confirm.messag: It has %s entries. Nothing is written until you save.
tabtailor.sections.error.load: Could not read the tab file: %s
tabtailor.editor.tab_style.tooltip: Colors and images of this tab's section headers, side bar and window. Unset values come from the global look.
tabtailor.editor.global_style.tooltip: Colors and images for all tabs (tabtailor.json)
tabtailor.sections.style.tooltip: Colors and image of this section's header row
tabtailor.style.help.shadow: Draws the header text with a shadow.
tabtailor.style.help.image_frames: Number of frames stacked in the image. Empty = detected automatically.
tabtailor.style.help.image_frametime: Speed of an animated image in ticks per frame (20 ticks = 1 second).
tabtailor.style.help.image_hover_only: Animated images only move while the mouse is over the header.
tabtailor.style.help.keep_mod_colors: Lets mods keep their own title color and slot highlight.
